Anna (CS): Quick heads-up — Meridian QBR next Wed 2pm PT. I started a slim deck and action tracker. Need exec ask alignment and slide owners confirmed by EOD Tue. Ping if any blockers. :spiral_calendar:

Jordan (AM): Thanks. Can we add renewal risk slide? I'll own SLA + usage numbers. @Priya will you take enablement outcomes?

Priya (Enablement): Yup. I'll add adoption highlights + enablement lift (before/after metrics). Will need 2–3 bullet TL;DR. Tagging @Sam (Ops) for infra incidents summary.

Sam (Ops): I'll pull last 90d incidents and latency SLOs. Short list only. ETA EOD Monday.

Luis (Eng): I'll add a one-slide note on upcoming model rollouts that could affect latency/cost. Need wording sign-off from @Anna (CS).

Anna (CS): Perfect. Slide layout I used:

```text
1. Exec summary (Anna)
2. Health + usage (Jordan)
3. Renewal risks & asks (Jordan)
4. Enablement outcomes (Priya)
5. Incidents & reliability (Sam)
6. Model/infra risks (Luis)
7. Action items & next steps (Anna)
```

Jordan (AM): For renewal asks: propose 10% discount for 12-mo commit + support credit. Drafting wording now.

Priya (Enablement): Also capture customer feedback: primary training gap = "deployment templates". I'll attach survey snippet.

Luis (Eng): Quick note — model rollout dates tentative: May 8–10. If that's within QBR window we should mark as "tentative".

reminder-bot: Reminder set — "Meridian QBR: deck & owners due" on Tue 17:00 PT.

Anna (CS): Action tracker (short): jordan — renewal asks wording (due Mon 11am); priya — slide + survey excerpt (due Mon 5pm); sam — incident summary (due Mon EOD); luis — model slide + wording (due Tue EOD). I'll consolidate and send to execs Wed 9am PT.

Jordan (AM): Acknowledge. Will share numbers + one-paragraph risk statement.

Priya (Enablement): I'll upload the draft slide to the deck folder: https://drive.redwood/inbox/meridian-qbr (preview). Will add speaker notes.

Anna (CS): Thanks everyone. If no objections, I'll send the exec pre-read Tuesday morning. :thumbsup:
